_nota: Inglés de objetos, cassettes y ataques de los héroes. Los objetos y sueltos van por id; los ataques y especiales, por su nombre en español, porque la partida guarda lo equipado con ese nombre.

atq.texto: {quien} downs the Red Fury in one go. A sports drink; nobody knows which sport. Attack +{n} until the end of the fight.

def.texto: {quien} takes a blue pill. It's not what you think. Well, a little. Defense +{n} until the end of the fight.

vida.texto: {quien} drinks the still water: +{n} HP. The cheapest thing on the menu and the only one that never lies to you.

carga.texto: {quien} drinks a 4Low-Co. The special bar fills up. Your liver, the other way around.

caramelo_rancio.texto: {quien} eats the stale candy. It tastes like a closed bar and bad decisions. Raises {n} levels at once.

revivir.texto: {quien} drinks the Elixit and gets back up: +{n} HP. Pink serum for after a bad night, or after dying.

veneno_ratas.texto: Someone slips rat poison to {quien}. They lose HP every turn. The label says "not for humans". Nobody reads labels.

condon.texto: {quien} gets a cheap, no-brand condom. It's protection: the next hit does nothing.

revivir_plus.texto: {quien} drinks the Elixit++ and gets back up with full health: +{n} HP.

condon_spartan.texto: {quien} gets a Spartan condom. The next hit does nothing to anyone in the party.

hepatol.texto: {quien} takes the Hepatol. The poison goes away.

pastelillo_herbal.texto: {quien} eats an herbal brownie: +{n} HP. All their health is back… and the world gets weird. They're confused.

gorra_repartidor.texto: Head. +2 SPD. Gets there fast; still gets there late.

casco_obra.texto: Head. +4 DEF, −1 SPD. Safety first, except in the paycheck.

lentes_lectura.texto: Head. +5% crit. For spotting other people's mistakes.

vincha_anime.texto: Head. +3 ATK. Yells the attack's name louder.

delantal_billy.texto: Outfit. +5 DEF, −2 SPD. A tank, like Billy.

chanclas.texto: Feet. +4 SPD, −2 DEF. Comfort over dignity.

cafe_maquina.texto: {quien} drinks a vending machine coffee. Tastes like cardboard, but it works: bar +{n}.

botiquin_oficina.texto: {quien} opens the office first-aid kit: expired band-aids and some faith. +{n} HP.

antidoto_universal.texto: {quien} takes the universal antidote. Universal according to the label: the statuses go away.

proteina.texto: {quien} drinks the vanilla Smart Flab protein. Attack +2 for good.

crema_antiarrugas.texto: {quien} puts on the anti-wrinkle cream. Steel skin: defense +2 for good.

caramelo_acido.texto: {quien} eats the sour candy. Drops one level. Nobody knows why anyone would want this.

cebidol.texto: {quien} takes a CeBiDol. Attack +2 and defense +2 for good. The leaflet says "consult your doctor". Nobody has a doctor.

pastillas_felices.texto: Someone gives {quien} happy pills. They smile, wobble and no longer know which side to fight for.

galleta_arcoiris.texto: {quien} shares the rainbow cookie: +{n} HP and one status goes away.

galleta_brownie.texto: {quien} eats a brownie cookie: +{n} HP and one status goes away.

galleta_red_velvet.texto: {quien} eats a red velvet cookie: +{n} HP and one status goes away.

caramelo_dulce.texto: {quien} eats the sweet candy. Raises {n} level.

placa_piloto.texto: Charm. +5% crit. A pilot's eye: knows where to hit.

pendulo_hipnosis.texto: Amulet. Near-certain crit against a sleeping target. You're getting very sleepy… and hit.

libreta_sesiones.texto: Head. Near-certain crit against a confused target. Writes down everything you say. Uses it against you.

bata_psicologa.texto: Outfit. +2 DEF and +50% damage against a sleeping target. Dreams come with a bill too.

pantuflas_divan.texto: Feet. +50% damage against a confused target. Soft steps, hard questions.

lentes_programador.texto: Head. +5% crit and +1 DEF. Blue-light filter: bugs show up from a mile away. Your own problems, not so much.

Cebo paralizante.texto: {quien} leaves a copy of themselves. Whoever hits it cramps up all over. [Filler]

Cebo tóxico.texto: {quien} leaves a copy of themselves. Whoever hits it gets poisoned. [Filler]

Cebo confuso.texto: {quien} leaves a copy of themselves. Whoever hits it gets confused. [Filler]

Cebo caliente.texto: {quien} leaves a copy of themselves. Whoever hits it gets burned. [Filler]

Cebo frío.texto: {quien} leaves a copy of themselves. Whoever hits it freezes. [Filler]

Cebo sueño.texto: {quien} leaves a copy of themselves. Whoever hits it falls asleep. [Filler]

Cebo explosivo.texto: {quien} leaves a copy of themselves. It blows up in the face of whoever hits it; its owner gets some too. [Filler]

Autodestrucción.texto: {quien} presses the button nobody should press. [Filler]

Multicebo.texto: {quien} focuses and the field fills with black-and-white copies: one in front of each of them. [Filler]

Bomba del día del juicio.texto: {quien} leaves a bomb in the middle of the field. It goes off in 5 turns. [Filler]

Piedra.texto: {quien} picks a rock off the floor and throws it at {objetivo}. Cutting-edge technology. [Filler: test cassette]

Grito de guerra.texto: {quien} yells something nobody understands. Feels invincible. Isn't. [Filler: test cassette]

Botella rota.texto: {quien} hits {objetivo} with a broken bottle. Don't ask which bar it came from. [Filler: test cassette]

Puñetazo eléctrico.texto: {quien} winds up the punch like at the gym and hits {objetivo} with a sparking punch. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Combo de calle.texto: {quien} throws two quick hits at {objetivo}, the kind that never show up in any technique video. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Ctrl+Z de gimnasio.texto: {quien} chugs the protein shake and stretches the neck. Like nothing happened. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Ráfaga relámpago.texto: {quien} gets serious for the first time today and unleashes a barrage of sparking punches. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Corte de carnicero.texto: {quien} raises the butcher-knife sword and brings down on {objetivo} a slash that cuts through the table. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Panzazo.texto: {quien} shoves {objetivo} with the belly. With conviction. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Brindis.texto: {quien} raises a mug: «To the house!». Downs it in one go. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Pastelillo de la casa.texto: {quien} offers {objetivo} an herbal cupcake «with extra compound T». {objetivo} no longer knows where they are. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Parrillada Beef Boy.texto: {quien} fires up the grill in the middle of the fight. The meat goes flying. So do the rivals. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Onda psíquica.texto: {quien} puts two fingers to the temple and sends {objetivo} a wave you can't see but can feel. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Hipnosis clínica.texto: {quien} swings a pendulum in front of {objetivo}: «You're in a safe place…». [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Lectura del subconsciente.texto: {quien} looks {objetivo} in the eye and says something from their childhood nobody knew. {objetivo} no longer knows who they are. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Sesión de grupo.texto: {quien} gathers every rival in an invisible circle of chairs. The waves reach them all at once. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Selfie con flash.texto: {quien} takes a selfie with {objetivo} in the background. The flash goes straight into the eyes. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Unboxing violento.texto: {quien} opens a sponsored package with fists. The box ends up in {objetivo}'s face. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Colaboración pagada.texto: A sponsor sends {quien} a drink. Drunk while looking at the camera. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Transmisión en vivo.texto: {quien} starts a live stream. The comments pour in. So do the hits. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Foto sin permiso.texto: {quien} snaps a photo of {objetivo} without asking. The flash leaves them frozen. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Explicación del lore.texto: {quien} explains to {objetivo} the whole timeline of a 400-episode saga. {objetivo} starts nodding off. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Abrazo de almohada.texto: {quien} hugs a printed pillow and hides behind it. Nothing gets through. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Técnica prohibida del episodio 400.texto: {quien} yells the name of a technique that only exists in an episode nobody else watched. {objetivo} understands nothing. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Puñetazo.texto: {quien} closes their eyes and throws a punch. Statistically, one had to land.

Cebo.texto: {quien} stands still for a second and leaves a black-and-white copy of himself there. It's the first thing any fighter learns. And the only thing Jair uses at the office.

Ctrl+Z.texto: {quien} presses Ctrl+Z in the air. It doesn't undo the hit, but it feels better. [Filler: test move, no new sprites]

Reunión que pudo ser un correo.nombre: Meeting That Could've Been an Email
Reunión que pudo ser un correo.texto: {quien} calls {objetivo} into an hour-long meeting. {objetivo} can't move from boredom. [Filler: test move, no new sprites]

Excusa elaborada.texto: {quien} explains to {objetivo} why it isn't their fault. With diagrams. {objetivo} no longer knows whose side they're on. [Filler: test move, no new sprites]

Commit a medianoche.texto: {quien} pushes an untested change at midnight. It hits {objetivo} with all the force of irresponsibility. [Filler: test move, no new sprites]

Ráfaga de puños.texto: {quien} yells something learned from an anime and lets loose a flurry of punches. None with technique. All with faith.

Tiro certero.texto: {quien} breathes, aims and fires just once. No need for more. [Filler: test move, no new sprites]

Barrido de cobertura.texto: {quien} sweeps the front with short bursts. A little for everyone. [Filler: test move, no new sprites]

Lluvia de plasma.texto: {quien} stands in the middle, draws the second pistol and fires nonstop. High, middle, low. At everyone.

Armored.texto: {quien} covers up in metal plates. The helmet's eyes light up. What comes next isn't a fight: it's paperwork. [Filler: Cami armored and berserk sprites missing]

Espada.texto: {quien} draws. The petals arrive before the blade.

Curación.texto: {quien} joins her hands and closes her eyes. A green light surrounds her.

Pétalos al viento.texto: {quien} spins and a rain of petals cuts everyone in front. [Filler: test move, no new sprites]

Postura de la guardiana.texto: {quien} stands firm as on her bridge. Nothing gets through. [Filler: test move, no new sprites]

Tajo de primavera.texto: {quien} draws in the blink of an eye. Five hundred years of practice in a single cut.

Copia de fan.texto: {quien} learned the choreography by heart and gives {objetivo} back exactly what they got. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Barra luminosa.texto: {quien} hits {objetivo} with the official lightstick, limited edition. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Canto de estadio.texto: {quien} screams the band's chant so loud it hurts everyone. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]

Fancam.texto: {quien} pulls out her phone, films vertically and charges forward like she's in the front row. [Filler: Claude draft, no sprites of their own]
